dispatch.headline: Guests Brawl Over First Tear
dispatch.body:
Ooligan Ridge - Following Sunday's brawl at the Vapour Deck funeral of the Sterling family, head protocol clerk Kaelen Mbatha remains firm that his staff handled the disturbance with standard decorum.

The fight broke out forty minutes into the service. Eighteen mourners brawled over the cloud-condenser valve to deposit the inaugural grief drop.

"The order of moisture is strict," Mbatha said. "The prime heir clears their nasal passages first. Then the spouse drops one tear into the condenser funnel to scent the weather array."

The argument began when Delphine Sterling stepped toward the funnel ahead of the eldest nephew.

"Delphine brought a saline bulb in her wrap," Mbatha said. "That is an illegal discharge. The nephew tackled her into the orchid basin, and three cousins joined with salad forks."

The brawl lasted twenty minutes. Nine guests were treated for broken ribs, and four fell into the cloud layer.

"The family showed real devotion," Mbatha said. "The air output from that service will rain purified salt over the lower decks for weeks."

When asked about the contents of the sealed casket, Mbatha checked his slate.

"We are still waiting on the manifest," he said. "It could be Great-Uncle Hector. Or the gene-hound."

He adjusted his collar. "Either way, the moisture yield was remarkable."
dispatch.scene: Dressed in flowing formal silks, two mourners wrestle over a tall silver funnel while a clerk in a crisp uniform checks a glowing slate.

glossary.gloss: A high-platform atmosphere processor that converts ritual fluid contributions into atmospheric mist.

dispatch.premise: Cloud-city socialites at a high-altitude wake erupt into a devastated, tearful brawl over who is entitled to shed the first tear into the platform's prestige atmospheric condenser, completely unaware of which family member is in the coffin.

brief.subject: a protocol clerk in a high-collared gray tunic
brief.action: sweeping broken glazed ceramic shards and crushed petals into a flat metal tray
brief.setting: a metal-grid deck beside a tall silver condensation funnel mounted on a tripod
brief.light: flat pale daylight coming through a thick cloud layer overhead
brief.materials: brushed steel, dark glazed ceramic, synthetic weave, wet orchid stalks
brief.anomaly: a pair of bent four-pronged salad forks resting in a shallow puddle on the metal floor
